meta.name: sentiment-analysis
meta.description: Analyze user feedback data to identify segments with sentiment scores, JTBD, and product satisfaction insights. Use when analyzing user feedback at scale, running sentiment analysis on reviews or surveys, or identifying satisfaction patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析用户反馈中的情感倾向与满意度模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从大量用户反馈中提取情感洞察和满意度趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze sentiment and satisfaction patterns from user feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract sentiment insights and satisfaction trends from large volumes of user feedback.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你提供的用户反馈数据（如评论、调查），识别不同用户群体，给出每个群体的满意度评分、痛点、改进建议。
howto.when: 当你上传用户反馈文件（如 CSV、PDF）或粘贴评论、调查结果，并要求分析情感或满意度时触发。

say.text: 分析这份用户评论 CSV，找出不同用户群体的满意度。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并输出各群体的情感评分和洞察。

say.text: 对这批调查反馈做情感分析，列出主要痛点。
say.note: Claude 会提取负面主题并给出改进建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes user feedback data (e.g., reviews, surveys) to identify user segments, assign sentiment scores, and provide actionable insights like pain points and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload feedback files (CSV, PDF) or paste review/survey data and ask for sentiment analysis or satisfaction insights.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV of user reviews and identify segments with sentiment scores.
say_en.note: Claude reads the file and outputs segment profiles with sentiment.

say_en.text: Run sentiment analysis on these survey responses and list top pain points.
say_en.note: Claude extracts negative themes and suggests improvements.
